messages:
anya: quick async check — planning to flip the `micro_batch_quantization` feature flag to enable low-precision micro-batching for the latency-sensitive text-gen routes. targeting ~1% traffic (small internal cohort) starting tomorrow 09:00 PT. any immediate blockers or vetoes?

mike: do we have the cohort defined? size + orgs? also which endpoints exactly?

anya: cohort = internal-beta + 5% of team API keys, ~2000 qps max. endpoints: `/v1/generate` and `/v1/chat/stream` for the small audience only. config snippet: ```json
{"flag":"micro_batch_quantization","audience":"internal-beta+5pct","profiles":["fp16","int8-mb"],"rollout":"gradual"}```

raj: important: add a telemetry tag `quant_rollout_v2` so we can filter. we should monitor: p50/p95 latency, token error rate, and subtle drift in perplexity on eval prompts. I can add tracking to the dashboard.

kim: rollback triggers: if p95 latency rises >15% OR error_rate > 0.8% sustained for 5m, auto-disable. also if quality regression on eval set > 3% we kill. have runbooks linked?

anya: yup runbook is here: https://wiki.redwood/inference/rollouts/runbook#micro-batch-quant — includes manual rollback steps and owners. adding telemetry tag now.

sophia: pinging for code review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321 contains the flag, gate checks, and a unit test for kv-cache interaction. @mike @raj can you take a look today? small comment on naming but mostly ready.

mike: taking a look now. quick scan — need one more integration test for long-context streaming path. will add it and push.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: infra-canary job queued for 2026-09-14T16:00:00Z. Can be canceled in 10m with `/deploy cancel 4321`.

ops-bot: dashboard: https://dash.redwood/inference/rollouts/quant-v2?env=prod — added panels for p50/p95, errors, tokens/sec, and eval-set drift. alert policy `quant-rollout-v2-alert` will page on threshold breaches.

anya: perfect. plan: merge PR after integration test, schedule deploy for the window above, monitor first 30m closely. tagging owners: @kim (oncall), @raj (telemetry), @sophia (runtime). low-risk audience, but call if anything odd. :thumbsup:

mike: thumbs. will post review comments in PR.

raj: copying the short checklist here: 1) PR merged, 2) telemetry tag present, 3) dashboard panels live, 4) rollback thresholds configured, 5) smoke-run on canary. I will run step 5 at +5m after deploy.

anya: thanks team — will proceed unless a hard veto before 08:50 PT tomorrow.
